notes.title: The Apartment is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]🎮 [b]The Apartment is now available on Steam![/b]
Are you ready to hear footsteps echoing down the dark halls?[/p][p]"The Apartment" offers a chilling experience that blends psychological tension with atmospheric horror.
Starting today, it’s available as an [b]Early Access[/b] title on Steam![/p][p]🕯️ Uncover the dark secrets of your past
🔍 Detailed environments, subtle clues, and disturbing sound design
💀 Something might be watching you…[/p][p]The game is still in development, and your feedback means the world to us. Please share your thoughts and help shape the final experience.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773540/The_Apartment/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]
